Playing puzzle from %s folder. Check \'Puzzle info\' option for details.

There are several input modes which you can use to fill in the puzzle. In order to help you get familiar with these modes, there will be several hints displayed as you go through them. You can disable these hints in the game settings.
You\'re now in the Pop-up input mode. Choose any cell with tap to edit its content. Notice the button in the lower right corner. You can use this button to switch to another input mode.

You\'re now in the Insert on cell tap input mode. First select any key button by pressing it. Then just tap on cells in which you want to have the selected key applied. Press pencil marks button to enable the cell\'s pencil marks editing.

You\'re now in the Select on cell tap input mode. Buttons act as a standard keyboard. You need first to select cell by tapping it, then press button to modify the selected cell. Press pencil marks button to enable the cell\'s pencil marks editing.

Please remember that you don\'t have to use all input modes. You can disable any of them in the game settings. You can also use the keyboard and trackball to control the game. If you want to enter pencil marks using the keyboard, press number with alt (primary) or shift (secondary, if enabled).

Keyboard controls Use trackball to navigate to the desired cell and then press a number on the keyboard to fill in the value. If you want to edit the cell's pencil mark, press number with Alt (primary marks) or Shift (secondary, if enabled). 
Input modes You can switch between several input modes using the button in the lower right corner of the screen. You can also disable any input mode in the game settings, it will become then hidden during game. 
Pop-up input mode A pop-up dialog is shown when you tap the cell. You can edit cell's content using the dialog. 
Insert on cell tap mode Select any key button by pressing it, then just tap on a cell in which you want to have the selected number inserted. 
Select on cell tap mode Buttons act as a standard numeric keyboard. 
In any mode press pencil marks button to toggle the cell's pencil marks editing.

Open Sudoku is an Open Source Sudoku game.

Features:
	- Without ads
	- Puzzles can be downloaded from web, entered by hand or generated on the project's homepage
	- Game stats (time spent, mistakes)
	- Next step hints with multiple strategies suggestions
	- Import to and export from a file
	- Visual themes including custom theme editor
	- Several input modes (finger-friendly numpad, popup, keyboard etc.)
	- Double pencil marks
…and much more.
